headline: Airlines Incurred $24.5 Billion in Payment Processing Costs in 2025: IATA
summary: Global airlines spent $24.5 billion on transaction processing fees across $1.05 trillion in ticket sales in 2025, exerting significant pressure on net industry profitability, IATA reports.
why: The International Air Transport Association represents the global aviation sector, where tight operating margins are highly vulnerable to non-fuel overheads.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Payment processing fees exceeding 2% of gross revenue directly erode slim operating margins.

impacts.name: Payment Processors
impacts.why: Payment gateways and credit networks capture substantial fee revenue from global airline ticketing volume.
